description: Creates an MP3 of a melody (before or without saving it) or of a saved song, so you and the person can hear it. Pass either song_id or a melody (box, bpm, notes). Sounds: "synth" (free, the site's default sound) or "music_box" (real music box recordings for the box; PRO accounts only). Saved songs use the sound their author chose unless you pass one. Up to 5 minutes; 20 new audios a day without an account and 60 with one (the same melody again is free).

box.description: With song_id: which version. Otherwise the melody's box.

illegal_threshold_ticks.description: Minimum gap between two identical notes, in ticks (default 384 = 2 beats).

beat.description: When the note sounds, in quarter notes from 0 (e.g. 0, 1, 1.5).

pitch.description: Note name like "C5", "F#4", "Bb3", or a MIDI number (60 = C4).

ticks.description: Alternative to beat: 192 ticks per quarter note.

song_id.description: A saved song (public, the person's own, or one you saved without an account with its claim_token).

name: render_audio
title: Listen to a melody or song
